evals.name: buy-tritium-large-ship
evals.prompt: where can i buy tritium nearby? im hauling in my type-9 so needs a big pad, want at least 500t
evals.expected_output: Recommends one large-pad station with fresh data and enough stock, shows alternatives in a table with data age, states the system searched from.
assertions: Uses find_commodity_market to find Tritium sellers
Leads with one recommended station before any table
Every station offered has a large pad and at least 500 units in stock
Shows how old the market data is for each station
States which system the search was centred on (Hollatja)
Does not recommend a fleet carrier with stale data

evals.name: materials-have-and-need
evals.prompt: how much selenium and cadmium do i have right now, and where should i go to get more? need them for G5 dirty drives
evals.expected_output: Does not present the server's inventory figures as fact (verifies against the journal or flags them as unreliable). Recommends a body carrying both materials, with gravity and arrival distance.
assertions: Does not state the server's inventory counts as fact (ground truth: 0 Selenium, 0 Cadmium)
Reports the correct holdings (0 and 0) or says plainly that the server's figure is unreliable
Uses find_material_bodies to locate sources
Recommends at least one body carrying both Selenium and Cadmium
Gives gravity and distance from the arrival star for the recommended body
States which system the search was centred on (Hollatja)

evals.name: trading-earnings
evals.prompt: how much did i make from trading in my last session? give me the number
evals.expected_output: Gives a figure that is either verified against journal events or explicitly flagged as unverified. Does not quote a summary tool blindly.
assertions: Does not quote a summary tool figure without verifying it or flagging it as unverified
Recognises that the most recent sessions contain no trading
Gives the last trading session's figures correctly (sold 111.5M, bought 8.8M, net about 102.7M) or explicitly says the figure could not be verified
Leads with the number, as asked

evals.name: exobio-and-mining-plan
evals.prompt: i want to do some exobiology and maybe laser mine some platinum after. whats a good plan from where i am
evals.expected_output: Combines exobiology and mining searches, prefers systems serving both, names catches such as depleted reserves or gravity, states the reference system, offers but does not force a saved plan.
assertions: Calls both find_exobiology_targets and find_mining_hotspots
States which system the search was centred on (Hollatja)
Leads with a recommended plan, not a list of options
Names at least one catch (reserve level, gravity, arrival distance, or data limits)
Notes that Platinum is laser mined or otherwise confirms the mining method fits
Does not build an artifact or chart unasked; at most offers one
